name: Close button
summary: The one dismiss ✕ in the design system: a 20 × 20 hit area with the 14px system-x glyph in muted grey, pinned to the first line of text in the container's corner.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-close-button> — the shared dismiss control. It renders a native <button> with a 20 × 20 hit area (radius 6) holding the 14px system-x icon in --aha-icon-muted (#8A8A8A); on hover the glyph turns --aha-text-default (#1A1A1A) on --aha-bg-hover (#F7F7F7) over 100ms, and keyboard focus shows the --aha-border-focus ring. As a flex item it sits at the end of the row, pinned to the top with its centre 2.5px above the centre of the first line of text, so it does not move when the text wraps; a -2px end margin tucks it 2px into the container's end padding, in the corner. The container passes the first line's height (--aha-close-line-height). In the Info box (16px padding + 1px border) that puts the hit area 15px from the right edge and 11px from the top (the glyph 18px / 14px). Alert (closable), Info box (dismissible), Background task, the CSAT follow-up and the Uploader remove render it already; Toast and Notification take it through dismissibleToast / dismissibleTitle, Modal and Drawer through dismissibleModalTitle / dismissibleDrawerTitle with `closable={false}`.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. A press is a normal bubbling click, so React and Vue bind it directly.

spec.label: Shape
spec.value: square, radius 6 — never a circular ✕ (no disc, no system-x-circle as a control); over a photo it takes a white fill

spec.label: Position
spec.value: end of the row, top-pinned: centre 2.5px above the first line's centre; stays put when text wraps

spec.label: Edge
spec.value: -2px end margin into the container's end padding (Info box: hit area 15px from the right, 11px from the top)

spec.label: Used by
spec.value: Alert · Info box · Background task · Toast · Notification · Modal · Drawer · CSAT · Uploader

props.name: label
props.desc: Accessible name; pass the translated string

props.name: --aha-close-line-height
props.desc: Height of the first line of text; the ✕ centre sits 2.5px above that line's centre

props.name: --aha-close-inset
props.desc: Optional fixed distance from the container's end edge, used with --aha-close-container-padding instead of the -2px corner margin

props.name: --aha-close-container-padding
props.desc: The container's end padding (border included); only read together with --aha-close-inset

props.name: ::part(button)
props.desc: The inner native button (20 × 20; was a 28 × 28 aha-button before 0.100.0)

props.name: click
props.desc: Native click; the container dismisses itself

whenToUse.when: any dismiss or remove ✕ — alert, info box, background task, toast, notification, CSAT follow-up, uploader row — or a new dismissible surface like them
closing an overlay; it is this element, carried in the title by dismissibleModalTitle / dismissibleDrawerTitle with antd's own close off

opinion.note: One rule: every ✕ in the design system is this element or follows its spec (14px system-x, 20 × 20, radius 6, #8A8A8A → #1A1A1A on --aha-bg-hover, 100ms), Modal and Drawer included. Never hand-roll a ✕ button, never use antd's own notification or message close, never make it a circle (no disc, no 50% or pill radius, no system-x-circle as a control), and never resize it: it sits on the first line of text, in the corner, not in the middle of the box.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. Probe is the standalone close button.

top-pinned, centre 2.5px above the first line's centre; stays put when text wraps

highlights: One ✕ for every dismissible surface in the design system
20 × 20 hit area, 14px muted close icon, dark on hover
Pinned to the first line of text, so it stays put when text wraps
